My skin felt plump and hydrated all day, even under my mask I wore all day at work! I needed just a small amount to fully cover my face and neck. I noticed a slight eye irritation, like I get with SPF sometimes and was really sad, until I did a little experiment and realized it was the serum I was using along with the cream. Yay! No reason to not keep using it!! After two weeks, I definitely see a positive change in the texture of my skin, and a reduction of forehead and lip lines. I recently vacationed in the sunny south and returned to cold, dry Vermont with a teeny little sunburn. This cream kept my face feeling hydrated and healthy even with the dramatic temp and humidity changes. No flaking or peeling! Try this for yourself, it's fantastic!!

avis.titre: Moisturizers and keeps that moisture in.
avis.texte: The replenishing firming day cream is really great! I use it as a primer before applying my cosmetics. It's quickly absorbed, plus it makes my skin look even better under the foundation. In my much younger days, people used Vaseline on their skin, right after showering. This was not to moisturize per se, but it created a barrier to keep the moisture in ( this was also back when we used to slather ourselves with baby oil, and lay out in the sun for hours to get that perfect tan! ) Today we know not to be putting petroleum products on our skin, luckily for us, the firming day cream works very much like Vaseline used to, by locking in moisture, so it has definitely taken its place. Unlike petroleum products, it is a wonderful emollient. Keeping my skin moisturized in this dry desert climate of New Mexico can be quite a challenge, but this product really steps up and does the job!

avis.titre: Leaves my skin dewy and soft.
avis.texte: I received this product for free in exchange for my honest review. I have been using this about once a day for 3 weeks. My skin is extremely dry, so I like that this is moisturizing. This leaves my face so dewy and soft. It takes a few minutes to soak in, but I apply my foundation before this completely soaks in. It is thicker than I thought it would be, so a tiny amount goes a long way. This jar will probably last a full year. (Reminds me of a cold cream that my grandmother used to use. That's not a bad thing.) I haven't used it long enough to notice any long term changes, but I like it so far. My foundation looks much better after using this. I am not sure if this would be good for someone with oily skin, but definitely good for my dry skin.

I tried the Vichy Neovadiol Replenishing Firming Day Cream and I love how wonderful my face feels after using this product. I apply this after using the Vichy serum, it goes on so nice and smooth, the serum and Day Cream works wonderful together. My skin feels more hydrated and firm then ever before. I recommend this to all ladies experiencing menopause.

After application, it doesnt seem to absorb well, as it leaves a sheen on your skin (as you can see from photo). My skin felt slightly greasy. It may be a great product for someone with dry skin. I prefer a product that absorbs in, leaving your skin natural feeling.

Since I have dry skin (especially in the winter), I have been happy to see my face looking fresher and not dry. The vitamins and Niacinamide have been good for my skin. The cream didn't cause me to breakout either. I do notice a softening of my fine lines. The only thing I wasn't a fan of is the scent. It is strong. The scent didn't go away as the day went on. I could still smell the cream. That took a little getting used to. I will continue to use the cream because I feel the benefits outweigh that minor inconvenience.

avis.titre: Confidence Booster...I will continue to use this p
avis.texte: Vichy Neovadiol Replenishing Firming Day Cream targets mature skin, but can easily be used by any skin type. It has a rich creamy texture, is non-greasy and glides on smoothly. Since it absorbs quickly, I kept wanting to apply more but that's not necessary - A little goes a long way, so use sparingly. I noticed how the hydration level of my skin changed within days after using it. After 2 weeks, my fine lines were greatly diminished, heavier lines not as deep, age spots had faded, eye bags weren't as prominent and my face was more toned. I feel that I now have a brighter appearance giving me a healthier glow. This is one of the best moisturizers I have used to date. Had I been aware of Vichy I would have used it in my younger years. This day cream would be appropriate for any skin, not only peri/post menopausal women. I have been given a boost of confidence. I will continue to use this product! I found by using Vichy's serum and facial cream together, my wrinkles were diminished, age spots were not gone but had faded, my face was more toned with a brighter appearance.

My mature skin is starting to reveal itself due to the big M word. It looks tired, dry and dull and was starting to really bother me and then this little gem came to me to test in exchange for my honest review and holy wow! I'm obsessed, my skin is firmer, plumper and just glowing overall in appearance. I'm using it with the Meno Serum and seeing great results! I won't ever NOT use this line.
This product works nicely. It goes on smoothly and absorbs quickly. Gives your skin a nice glow. It does have a stronger fragrance than I like but it leaves after awhile.

avis.titre: It's good but not great for me
avis.texte: I was extremely grateful to try this product for free because I probably wouldn't have bought it on my own. I didn't mind it mostly and I know it sounds counter productive but I felt like the cream was just a little to heavy for my skin, and my skin is dry. I felt like it just didn't absorb as well as it could have. I didn't mind the texture, which is silky, and my face didn't react badly to it but it just didn't work for me. I also didn't notice any real difference between this and another product I've used in the past. I would however, recommend it only because it might work better for someone with a different skin type.

avis.titre: Most definitely would buy this product
avis.texte: I use the morning after cleaning my face. This product is rich & creamy. I love how makes my skin feel so soft & look softer.

I have used this day cream for a few weeks and I have noticed a difference. My face looks younger and it firmed my face for a smoother look. I love how this feels too. My face has moisture now which I have never had. I use this daily. Try this product, you will love it.

Used this cream on top of the serum per directions….. it is rich & creamy! Loved the feel of it as it settled into my skin. Not a noticeable difference in skin texture but will continue to use! Not much of a scent which I like!
The firming day cream kept my skin nice and soft all day. Absorbs nicely. The smell is pleasant as well.

avis.titre: This stuff feels incredible!! Two thumbs up!
avis.texte: I used this product in the morning and at night, and mainly used it on my neck. It was super rich but did not feel greasy or tacky, which is great. It is super moisturizing but I don't feel like it is pore-clogging, which is important to me. While I don't necessarily feel like it led to any skin tightening or anything like that, I will continue to use it as a really great moisturizer. Extra bonus—it smells absolutely HEAVENLY!

I have been using Neovadiol Replenishing Firming Day Cream for over 2 weeks and I see a remarkable difference in my skins appearance. I apply it after cleaning my face and after applying the Neovadiol Meno 5 Serum. My skin stays soft and supple. It goes on thick and you can feel it penetrate into your skin. No stinging. I am able to apply my makeup with ease. No rough spots. I plan on using this product from now on.

wow a very nice easy cream to use. I have dry and a little loss of firmness to my skin and this cream really helped it feel and look better. I found using to twice a day to be the most helpful with having my skin look well hydrated. Goes on smooth and blend in quickly. Great product.
Made my face feel smooth and soft. Use it morning and night. Great product

avis.titre: I would buy this product again!
avis.texte: This cream is more than i expected. It is light yet highly moisturizing and it has an amazing light scent. I have numerous dry areas on my face, eye brows, crease in my nose and crease in my lips mainly. I put this on after the serum has set in. The skin on my face is brighter and softer. I used to apply facial cream many times through the day and it didn't help. Since using the serum and cream it's a once a day application and im set now. I am extremely happy with the results.

I find most cream moisturizers to be too thick and feel heavy on my skin. I found this cream to be very light feeling on my skin. Only needed a small pea size amount to cover my face. I love how moisturized my skin feels after a week of use.
I use this product with the serum and it leaves my skin so soft! It's great under makeup as well. Love it!
